sanskrit_verse:
bahupratijñaṃ yat kāryaṃ vyavahāreṣu niścitaṃ /
kāmaṃ tad api gṛhṇīyād rājā tattvabṛbhutsayā // BrhS_1,2.40
transliteration: bahupratijñaṃ yat kāryaṃ vyavahāreṣu niścitaṃ / kāmaṃ tad api gṛhṇīyād rājā tattvabṛbhutsayā //
sph_interpretive_translation: Whatever action is decisively determined in judicial matters, even if it involves multiple commitments, the ruler must accept it willingly, out of a desire to know the truth.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from the capacity to uphold truth, not from coercive power.
Causation arises from alignment with factual integrity, not subjective intent.
Capacity-based responsibility demands that rulers assume decisions rooted in truth-discernment.
Restoration logic requires acceptance of consequences to sustain dharma.
Consciousness alignment occurs when authority acts in service of truth-revelation.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a judicial decision has been definitively established AND involves multiple enforceable obligations THEN the ruling authority MUST execute all components WITHOUT hesitation OR delegation.
IF the ruler's motivation is truth-discernment THEN the execution of judicial directives becomes self-evident AND non-negotiable.
IF an action is declared through verified pramāṇa THEN its implementation follows automatically within the consciousness-aligned governance framework.
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that judicial resolutions—regardless of complexity or multiplicity of obligations—must be embraced by the sovereign authority without reluctance. The criterion is not political convenience or institutional ease, but fidelity to truth-discernment as the highest directive.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based discernment determines the course of action. There is no imposition of consequence for failure; rather, there is natural alignment with what must be done when one operates from the standpoint of tattvabṛbhutsayā (truth-seeking). This reflects anupūrvaśaḥ—the sequential unfolding of right action once truth is known—and ensures proportional responsibility grounded in awareness, not compulsion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process where unexecuted judgments are revisited and fulfilled through conscious reaffirmation.
Activate responsibility assumption protocol wherein the ruler publicly aligns with the truth-value of the judgment.
Engage capacity restoration mechanism to ensure future rulings emerge from undistorted perception.
Implement integrity reintegration sequence to harmonize executive will with judicial insight.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored through willing alignment with truth. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
